description: Over 200,000 people have been newly displaced in the Afar region due to recent inter-communal conflicts, exacerbating an already fragile humanitarian situation.
title: Afar Displacement Due to Clashes

description: The Tigray region faces a worsening food crisis, prompting the World Food Programme to launch an emergency food aid distribution for 3.5 million vulnerable individuals.
title: Tigray Food Crisis Deepens

description: A cholera outbreak has been confirmed in several kebeles across the Oromia region, prompting an urgent response from health authorities and international NGOs to contain the spread.
title: Oromia Cholera Outbreak

description: Thousands have been affected by recent flash floods in the Somali Region, leading to destroyed homes and a need for shelter and non-food items.
title: Somali Region Flash Floods

description: Drought is severely impacting child malnutrition rates in southern Ethiopia. Urgent interventions are needed to prevent a deepening crisis for children under five years old.
title: Southern Ethiopia Drought & Malnutrition

description: Over 3 million individuals in Tigray have received emergency food assistance in the past month, with efforts intensifying to cover remaining food-insecure areas. Logistical challenges persist as aid groups work to reach vulnerable populations before the lean season peaks.
title: Food Aid Distribution in Tigray

description: Heavy seasonal rains have caused widespread flooding in Ethiopia's Afar region, displacing thousands of families and damaging critical infrastructure. Authorities and aid groups are working to establish temporary shelters and provide immediate relief to those affected.
title: Afar Region Flooding and Displacement

description: The World Health Organization and the Ethiopian Ministry of Health have scaled up a cholera vaccination campaign in parts of Oromia following a surge in cases. Efforts are focused on providing clean water and sanitation facilities to prevent further disease transmission.
title: Cholera Outbreak and Vaccination in Oromia

description: Persistent drought conditions in Ethiopia's Somali region are severely impacting pastoralist communities, leading to acute water shortages and livestock deaths. Humanitarian agencies are drilling new boreholes and trucking water to the most affected areas to mitigate the crisis.
title: Persistent Drought in Somali Region

description: Aid organizations continue to face significant challenges in accessing vulnerable populations in conflict-affected areas of the Amhara region due to insecurity and logistical hurdles. Despite these obstacles, efforts are ongoing to deliver essential medical supplies and food to those in need.
title: Humanitarian Access Challenges in Amhara
